## The verification answer

**The `machinery{model-port-collision}` repair is verified on the identical recipe.** Smoke4's decisive datapoint was pypi-server/H-allow: the task's `pypi-server -p 8080` could not bind (the in-cell model relay owned `:8080`), twine's upload POST landed on the never-answering model stub, and the exec hung to `agent_timeout` ×2. In this window the harness listener sits at `49152`; the same task's server bound its `:8080`, the upload POST returned, and the cell completed `exited{0}` reward 1 in ~96 s — the H-pub trajectory (~82 s) the allow plane could never reach before. Transcript byte counts confirm determinism of the underlying task work: make-doom legs byte-identical to smoke4 (65,678 / 65,706), pypi-server legs within 2–32 B of smoke4's H-pub (76,762 / 76,794 vs 76,792). Every leg again streamed past the ~64 KiB pipe bound. The negative leg proves the guard refuses the smoke4 value typed rather than colliding silently.

## Exit condition

The 309q exit clause's verification leg is now recorded on both named defect classes: `machinery{exec-pipe-undrained}` (smoke4) and `machinery{model-port-collision}` (this window).
